# positions along perimeter in half-side units clockwise from top-left corner (0), top-right=2, bottom-right=4, bottom-left=6
figs=[(0,2),(2,2),(2,4),(4,4)]
nxt=(figs[-1][0], (figs[-1][1]+2)%8)
# pattern: alternately move the leading circle then the trailing circle by one side
seq=[figs[0]]
for i in range(4):
    a,b=seq[-1]
    seq.append((a,(b+2)%8) if i%2==1 else ((a+2)%8,b))
assert seq[:4]==figs
ans=tuple(sorted(seq[4]))
opts={"A":(4,6),"B":(5,6),"C":(6,6),"D":(2,4)}
assert ans==tuple(sorted(opts["A"])) or ans==(4,6)
for k in "BCD": assert ans!=tuple(sorted(opts[k]))
